research_question.question: Does trace-v2 admit a score-independent, complete, replayable native candidate-event boundary on which M0, M1, and M2 can be compared over the identical event set and candidate set without depending on winner, claim, commit, or reveal information?
research_question.answer_detail: A unique pre-score lost-centric native universe is definable from frozen pair-record fields, reject-reason vocabulary, and native-universe sidecars. Completeness remains a future producer registration obligation, not an established H0 guarantee.

U_src.identity: immutable source pair-record space = every emitted pair_records row under h0_bridge_decision_trace_v2

U_evt.identity: runtime candidate-event space = one lost-instance bridge competition per (seq,frame,lost_slot,lost_instance_uid) under event_key_version

rho.identity: rho maps each pair row to exactly one event by projecting the lost-side event key fields
rho.rule: rho(pair) = event_key(seq, frame, lost_slot, lost_instance_uid, event_key_version)

C_e.identity: complete candidate universe for event e = set of candidate keys whose pair with the event lost identity is pre-score eligible

score_policy_spaces.tuple_immutability_rule: Any change to U_src, U_evt, rho, or C_e inclusion identity creates a different score policy and may not inherit prior score-ranking rungs.

event_identity.formation_runtime_point: At bridge-fire for a candidate with hit_streak==bridge_at, after the lost track is admitted as a structural competitor in the native pair scan and before claim/commit. Event membership is completed by grouping all structural/pre-score pairs that share the same lost identity on that capture sequence/frame.
event_identity.consistency_rule: Every pair row belonging to the same event must carry identical (seq, frame, lost_slot, lost_instance_uid). Divergence is invalid and fail-closed.

lifecycle.birth: first structural pair observation for the lost key at (seq, frame)
lifecycle.death: capture-frame boundary; no multi-frame trajectory reuse

candidate_identity.uniqueness_rule: Within one event, (cand_slot, cand_instance_uid) is unique. Across events, the same physical slot may reappear only with a distinct event_key and/or instance uid generation.
candidate_identity.exactly_one_event_membership: each included candidate belongs to exactly one event under rho

inclusion_stage.semantic_intent: after all declared non-score gates; before GCTM/baseline score ordering; before winner, claim, and commit

writer_proof.structural_entry: tracker_gpu.cu relink_bidir_propose_kernel structural lost scan admits competitors before height/speed/spatial gates; native_pair_keys and structural_competitors count them
writer_proof.pre_score_pass_counter: pre_score_passes increments only after height/speed/spatial pass (or are disabled)
writer_proof.reconstruct_from_pair_records: pair is pre_score_eligible iff reject_reason not in {HEIGHT, SPEED, SPATIAL}; disabled pre-score gates are non-rejecting

rejected_stages.structural_candidate_set: legal but not preferred: includes pairs that fail declared non-score gates and would mix gate interventions into pure score comparisons
rejected_stages.final_eligible_set: unsealable for pure score ranking: depends on baseline bdist cutoff and post-score vetoes; circular for GCTM score replacement

composition.candidate_inclusion_source: pair_records reconstructed at pre_score_eligible_v1, reconciled to native_pair_keys
composition.candidate_count_source: count of unique candidate keys in C_e for event e
composition.pair_row_reconciliation_rule: for every native_pair_key, exactly one pair_records row with identical stable key must exist when overflow counters are zero; otherwise the capture is partial and fail-closed
composition.overflow_rule: any overflow_* counter > 0 invalidates completeness for the affected stream and fail-closes universe sealing for that capture
composition.truncation_rule: silent truncation is forbidden; truncated rows must surface as overflow counters

label_boundary.attachment_rule_for_future_b1_evaluation: Labels attach offline to the frozen runtime (event_key, candidate_key) identities after universe sealing. Attachment may not rewrite U_evt, C_e, rho, inclusion stage, or drop-reason assignment. Labels never enter an H0 guarantee contract.

m0_m1_m2_conservation.inclusion_change_classification: If a future model changes candidate inclusion, the study is no longer a pure score-ranking comparison and must be declared as a gate/support intervention under the gate contract, not under score_ranking_evidence_contract_v1 pure score comparison.

claim_commit_boundary.note: Claim and commit streams remain available for later operator-layer audits but are outside runtime universe formation.

maximum_supported_conclusion: A runtime-native GCTM candidate-universe contract is structurally defined and is suitable as the consumer target for a separate minimal H0 registration/fidelity-edge delta.
